summary: The lit candle reaches do.c:dropx through the normal drop command, but preflight_dropx rejects every lamplit object before freeinv. This replay has an empty floor pile, so stackobj cannot absorb another object and cannot call the unsupported light-merge operations. C dropx/dropy/dropz leave a non-merging candle lit and preserve its burn timer while placing the same object on the floor. The existing JavaScript extraction, placement, timer and mobile-light owners already support that path. The smallest repair is bounded admission of non-globby lit drops when no compatible lit/timed/globby floor member would be absorbed; retain the merge and other current limits, without claiming whole drop-family completion.

source.branch: A hero on reachable dry ordinary terrain drops an inventory candle already lit, not unpaid/worn/attached, with no compatible special floor object to absorb. No swallowing, shipping consumption, liquid floor effects, shop billing or container impact occurs. The lamplit survivor remains the same object; only an absorbed compatible pile member needs light merging and timer deletion.
